claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves Efest IMR 18350 700mAh 15C as a 700mAh preset with a 15C runtime rating.
A 2014 Efest IMR 18350 700mAh test entry is purple, flat-top, unprotected, and measured 18.3 mm × 34.8 mm.

The Efest IMR 18350 catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
No reliable exact-model market-introduction date was established for Efest IMR 18350 in the 2026-08-04 catalog-wide research pass.
